subject: Business Models
title: Constraining the Market
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Constraining the Market.

hook.text: Tinder shows you one person at a time. A grid of 10,000 profiles would overwhelm you.

buildup.text: Constraining choice reduces paradox of choice and increases the probability of a successful match.

discovery.text: Airbnb limits search results to encourage booking. Showing every listing leads to analysis paralysis.

twist.text: Too much constraint feels manipulative. Users revolt when algorithms clearly withhold better options.

climax.text: The art of marketplace design is showing enough options to feel abundant but few enough to drive action.

punchline.text: Show less, convert more. Constraint drives decisions.

quiz.question: Why do marketplaces constrain the options shown to users?
options: To reduce choice paralysis and increase conversions
